CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #18
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible BIBLE? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Bible BIBLE with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use The Bible BIBLE to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible BIBLE.
   D. Say The Bible BIBLE has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Love of God and? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Love of God and with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Love of God and.
   C. Use Love of God and to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Love of God and has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of My family CREATION? (1 mark)
   A. Use My family CREATION to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of My family CREATION with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My family CREATION.
   D. Say My family CREATION has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Communicating to? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Communicating to with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Communicating to to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Communicating to has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Communicating to.

6. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Destroy trees without planting

7. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

8. Which response best shows understanding of Christian festivals: RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Christian festivals: RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS.
   B. Apply the teaching of Christian festivals: RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Christian festivals: RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Christian festivals: RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Christian rituals RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND? (1 mark)
   A. Use Christian rituals RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Christian rituals RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Christian rituals RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND.
   D. Apply the teaching of Christian rituals RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Who is CREATION? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Who is CREATION.
   B. Apply the teaching of Who is CREATION with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Who is CREATION to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Who is CREATION has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Birth of Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Birth of Jesus.
   B. Say Birth of Jesus has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Birth of Jesus to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Birth of Jesus with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Church as a place? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Church as a place with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Church as a place to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Church as a place.
   D. Say Church as a place has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Christian rituals RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Love of God and and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
